text: How to cut, upload & edit a podcast in U⚡️Sportz
Open Podcasts, then tap the My Podcasts tab.
Enter a Podcast Title (required). Description is optional.
Tap Choose audio file. Audio files must be under 100MB.
Tap Trim. The Start and End handles keep ONE continuous section.
The first 30 seconds are selected at first. Drag End to your episode length.
Drag Start to skip a slow intro.
Tap Preview to listen. Add a Fade In or Fade Out if you want.
Tap Apply Trim. The original file on your device stays unchanged.
Optional: tap Choose thumbnail. Then tap Upload Podcast.
Later, find the episode under Your Podcasts and tap Edit.
Change the Title, Description, Thumbnail or Audio, then tap Save changes.
Edit has no trimmer: prepare an edited copy, then use Replace Audio.
Cut. Upload. Edit. Now go share your game. (Illustrative walkthrough)
